map_info.name: Vectors_Act4b_Oscillation
map_info.title: Restoring Forces and Balance
map_info.description: Displace a spring, release it from rest and compare free, lightly damped, critical and heavy damping. A horizontal spring model accumulates velocity and displacement; the wall displays its instantaneous force budget. Existing balances and prescribed pendulums remain supporting exhibits.

learning_objectives: Restoring force opposes displacement; damping opposes velocity
Compare crossing and settling after release
Change mass or stiffness while identifying what state is retained
Distinguish an integrated spring from prescribed periodic movement

intro.text: Displace the spring and release it. Does returning mean stopping?
intro.speaker: Act IV

truth_spring.text: One force opposes displacement; another opposes velocity. Watch when they agree.
truth_spring.speaker: Spring

truth_pendulum.text: Similar motion can be integrated from forces or prescribed by a clock. Inspect which this exhibit does.
truth_pendulum.speaker: Pendulum

truth_momentum.text: What is changing here, and which rule produces the change?
truth_momentum.speaker: Momentum
